اعلوطت (form XIII)
# اِعْلَوَّطْتُ (iʕlawwaṭtu) /iʕ.law.watˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اِعْلَوَّطْتَ (iʕlawwaṭta) /iʕ.law.watˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اِعْلَوَّطْتِ (iʕlawwaṭti) /iʕ.law.watˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اِعْلَوَّطَتْ (iʕlawwaṭat) /iʕ.law
